task.description: Stable illumination outside the original twelve-hour dark interval and continuously available link remove shadow/outage interactions; strict energy, sample, timestamp and service requirements remain.

integration.scope: Frozen constructed one-second consumer; refinement cannot change integration or evaluator.

load.scope: Declared regulated-output energy impulses with positive completion durations, ESR/dropout and conversion guards; background includes a current-availability gateway beacon listener. No compiled MCU, RF, switching or NVM device calibration.

pmic.relation: OFF: Vin=1.8V; ON: Vin=1.8+Vstore/5, diode I(Vin), Pbus=.75*Vin*I. Idealized controlled input loading, no MPPT/switching or specific PMIC claim.

Profile.provenance: Prospective explicit constructed coefficients, not a fitted/vendor/physical device profile; no old A/R qualification inherited.

pv.temperature_scope: Only the declared fixed 25 C PV junction, no unbound temperature scaling.

clock_contract.resynchronization: Only an actual available-gateway sync event can restore absolute time; every failed or unknown timestamp remains in evaluation.
clock_contract.scope: Constructed bounded oscillator assumption. RTC continuation must consume power; no oscillator advance through unpowered periods without an explicit powered retention domain.

public_inputs.domain_scope: Finite development action box within the existing constructed consumer. Sampling30..60s and retries10..3600s bound retained event output; the original60s service maximum remains unchanged. No claim to every configuration the low-level consumer can encode.
public_inputs.exposure: Prospectively frozen before stage2 outcomes; new stage3 schedules.

feedback_access.scope: Current retained result only; detail observe/verify has no simulation or candidate evaluation. Sampled lists keep exact counts; final memory/pending are sampled with exact counts.

fixed_program_semantics.clock_continuation: Only while powered; reset loses synchronization; no unpowered clock.
fixed_program_semantics.gateway_beacon: Current available beacon while powered; charged sync phase on initial/new availability. No future schedule access.
fixed_program_semantics.storage: Atomic SAVE/ACK after paid completion; interrupted pending write discarded; persistent image survives reset only when enabled.

public_inputs.observations: Only powered quantized samples, device record/time intervals, actual wire/receiver, activity and supply/energy facts; no ideal air truth or hypothetical missing samples.

optical_environment.source_identity: Constructed public spectrum; not an Epishine characterization lamp or a measured cold-chain light trace.
optical_environment.spatial_scope: Uniform attenuation over every cell; nonuniform substring shading/mismatch is MODEL_DOMAIN until a per-cell reference is bound.

thermal_contract.model_scope: Local probe-to-air lag and quantization only; contents-core temperature, full box CFD, external-to-internal heat transport and self-heating are not certified.
thermal_contract.sensor_reading: Program obtains sensor temperature only at powered acquisition events; it cannot read ideal air truth or retrospective samples.

service.gap_markers: Must describe known missing intervals but do not satisfy continuous sampling.
service.history: Every committed record retained without corruption; receive all pre-recovery unacknowledged records by64920 in acquisition order with no duplicate logical samples.
service.new_sample_receive_scope: Samples created while gateway is available, including those created at/after64800; use acquisition time, not frame live/history label.
service.temperature_reference: independent air-point truth at actual acquisition time
service.timestamp_requirement: Known absolute acquisition time or an uncertainty interval containing truth with width<=120s and midpoint error<=60s; UNKNOWN time fails this strict service.

assumptions: Original 24h service and spatial/optical hard bounds remain fixed.
The declared finite development action box changes real supply/activity/record/receive behavior.
A sampling gap or unknown-time record is not valid continuous history.
initial_problem.local_objective: Meet every applicable frozen LC-PV service; report scope of any remaining failure.
